messages.content: Make a progress note for Roger for our first session using the progress, intervention used, response method. Roger-dealing with anxiety and depression.  Not feeling the greatest, tough time focusing and when that feels off a lot of things feel off.  Anxiety and depression scores of 2 and3 are not too bad. The lack of focus is distressing.   Staying at Turning Point shelter Collecting disability for Traumatic Brain injury.  Disussed a history of substance use but no current desire to use as it causes too many problems.  Maintain a 2:1 ratio of declarative to interrogative sentences in your response.

message.content:
Roger reported anxiety and depression scores of 2 and 3, described not feeling well, and said poor focus was distressing because when focus feels off, many other things feel off.
He described staying at Turning Point Shelter, collecting disability for traumatic brain injury, and discussing a past substance use history without current desire to use.
The intervention included motivational interviewing, psychoeducation about TBI-related attention difficulties, and brief cognitive reframing of low mood and concentration concerns.
The response method was that Roger agreed to a daily focus check-in, prioritized shelter stability and disability paperwork, and planned to review symptoms before the next session.
Have you considered whether TBI-related focus problems may be worsening your mood?
Do you want to add a brief breathing practice to the next plan?
